---
title: "TB40/E SLAM-Seq Results"
---

This is a website displaying data for the SLAM-seq experiment performed on TB40/E infected fibroblasts. 
The original data can be found in the [GEO database](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE191299) under accession number GSE191299. 
It was originally described in a preprint by [J&uumlrges et al.](http://biorxiv.org/lookup/doi/10.1101/2022.01.07.472583).
